    while i * i <= n:
        if n % i:
            i += 1
        else:
            n //= i
            factors.append(i)
    if n > 1:
        factors.append(n)
    return factors

            i += 1
        elif left_cars[i] > right_cars[j]:
            j += 1
        else:
            collisions += 1
            i += 1
            j += 1
    return collisions

    x_num, x_den = map(int, x.split('/'))
    n_num, n_den = map(int, n.split('/'))

    product_den //= product_gcd
    return product_den == 1
